semantic_contract.economic_sequence: frozen V3 collapse-gap-zone -> frozen E1 executable entry -> legally unresolved checkpoint state -> normal rejection/oscillation or failure-to-resolve process -> future legal U resolution or unresolved severe tail
semantic_contract.mission: estimate whether the frozen zone-resolution hypothesis remains alive at completed checkpoint close; not generic return prediction and not a stop replay
frozen_identity: E1 entry raw and coordinate price
semantic_contract.extrema_clock: exact one-minute bars from E1 entry_time through checkpoint close, inclusive; no pre-entry portion of D0
semantic_contract.completed_close_clock: D0 close through checkpoint close inclusive for close-share and rejection diagnostics
semantic_contract.hypothetical_action_clock: no earlier than the next legal session after checkpoint; no action is replayed in V1

dynamic_cohort.active_unresolved: frozen E1 exists; no legal U execution by checkpoint close; checkpoint states observable under original lineage; no QD-010 censor/risk exit by checkpoint
dynamic_cohort.horizon_label_eligibility: C<H and either legal U is observed by H before Development ends, or entry_cal_idx+H is observable no later than 2021-12-31; any QD-010 censor before target/H makes that horizon label ineligible

outcomes.unresolved_d60: no legal U execution through D60
outcomes.severe_unresolved_d60: UNRESOLVED_D60 and (terminal net at D60 <= -10% or MAE through D60 <= -20%)
outcomes.future_loss10_before_u: strictly after checkpoint and strictly before legal U/D60, coordinate low <= 90% of entry coordinate price
outcomes.future_loss20_before_u: strictly after checkpoint and strictly before legal U/D60, coordinate low <= 80% of entry coordinate price
outcomes.same_target_bar_adverse_order: unknown; target bar is excluded from future-loss and future-MAE-before-U calculations

state_dictionary.max_progress_raw: (maximum coordinate high from E1 entry through C - L)/W
state_dictionary.mae_entry_to_c: minimum coordinate low from E1 entry through C divided by entry coordinate price minus one
state_dictionary.recovery_to_l: 1 when post-entry low>=L, otherwise (close C-post-entry low)/(L-post-entry low)
state_dictionary.underwater_share: D0..C completed closes below entry coordinate price divided by C+1
state_dictionary.below_l_share: D0..C completed closes below L divided by C+1
state_dictionary.low_structure: for C>=5 compare minimum exact post-entry session low over C-2..C with C-5..C-3 using absolute coordinate tolerance 1e-10
state_dictionary.rejection_episodes: distinct transitions into completed close below L from D0 through C; diagnostic only

surfaces: distance_bin Z1/Z2 x recovery_bin for close below L

verdict_implementation.material_candidate: at D5 or D10: unresolved lift>=2, precision minus base>=10 percentage points, tail capture>=20%, resolver contamination<=50%, winners sacrificed<=15%
verdict_implementation.timely_candidate: median gross mark-to-market loss at first frozen-checkpoint trigger>-10% and at least 50% of first triggers occur before -10%
verdict_implementation.checkpoint_stable: lift>=1.5 at two or more applicable checkpoints including D5 or D10
verdict_implementation.year_stable: among at least four years with state N>=3, lift>1 in at least 60% of supported years and at least three years
verdict_implementation.board_stable: state N>=10 and lift>1 in both MAIN and CHINEXT at D5 or D10
verdict_implementation.date_robust: reentry-date-equal and formation-date-equal lift>1.25 at the same qualifying checkpoint
verdict_implementation.not_age_only: at least one persistence group <=120 sessions has state N>=10 and lift>1.25
verdict_implementation.not_target_distance_only: at least two target-distance terciles have state N>=10 and lift>1
verdict_implementation.separable: one candidate satisfies material, timely, checkpoint, year, board, date, age, and target-distance conditions
verdict_implementation.only_after_damage: a candidate is material or weakly informative but fails timing because median first-trigger loss<=-10% or fewer than 50% trigger before -10%
verdict_implementation.weakly_separable: no separable candidate, but one candidate at D5 or D10 has lift>=1.5, precision minus base>=5 percentage points, tail capture>=10%, and either material or checkpoint-stable evidence
